name: @ftslang/content-mapper
description: TypeScript content mapper and proposal lowering for FTS

scripts.build: npm run build:types && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --sourcemap && esbuild src/mapper.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/mapper.cjs --sourcemap
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --project integration
